mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4% triggers a labor market contraction, reducing corporate hiring and investment, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in residential construction spending above 1.5% of GDP signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in industrial production above 3% growth signals a strengthening manufacturing sector, which boosts corporate earnings and reduces equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
